description: Create a SENS project (POST /common/v2/projects). projectName: lowercase letters, digits, '-' and '_', ≤24 chars. Enable at least one of useSms / useKkoBizMsg (the API rejects a project with no service). The account must already have accepted the SENS Terms of Service and Privacy Policy in the console — the API has no agreement field and returns 'You must agree to both the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy' otherwise. Returns the created channel service IDs (NRN).

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without creating

useKkoBizMsg.description: Enable the Biz Message (Kakao) service (default false)

name: ncloud_sens_create_project
